text: 财政部将发行特别国债支持8家中央金融企业补充资本 财政部将于近期发行3000亿元特别国债，支持8家中央金融企业补充核心一级资本。
text_en: Finance Ministry to issue special treasury bonds to support capital replenishment of 8 central financial enterprises; ministry will issue 300 billion yuan in special treasury bonds soon to support core Tier-1 capital replenishment of 8 central financial enterprises.
